inlineImageAndParagraph.text: Merchant onboarding solutions help banks and payment service providers onboard merchants faster while ensuring accurate classification, compliance readiness, and risk visibility. Modern onboarding infrastructure uses digital intelligence to understand a merchant’s real business activity, validating MCC categories, identifying fraud indicators, and reducing operational friction. For banks and PSPs, onboarding is the foundation for risk monitoring, compliance alignment, and long-term merchant lifecycle management.

inlineImageAndParagraph2.text: Merchant acquisition volumes are increasing across UPI, current accounts, and payment infrastructure. At the same time, inaccurate merchant classification and delayed risk identification can create operational and regulatory challenges. Institutions today need onboarding infrastructure that goes beyond document collection.

bulletPoints: Early-stage intelligence enables banks and PSPs to monitor merchant behavior more effectively and maintain structured onboarding processes.
